title: Screens values
description: The file game/tuning/screens.json: the look of the menu, the pause box, the game-over screens, the instructions page, the leaderboard, the credits page and the version label: colors, glow, glass, fonts and the size and gaps of each screen, read in both run modes. Every field is required: no default lives in code. Nothing is baked into a picture file: the glass, the glow, the icons and the text are drawn once at startup. Range by field name: a name ending _alpha is a whole number 0 to 255, _strength a number 0 to 1, and _size, _w, _h and _pitch (and a field named w, h or size) a whole number of 1 or more; any other whole number is 0 or more, and any other number is 0 or more. All values are guesses from the screens brainstorm (10-ui.md, screens_look). Loaded and checked by game/app/screens_tuning.py at startup into ui.screen_rules.ScreenRules. Look only: no field changes play. Owner of the schema: architect.

palette.description: The screens' colors as #rrggbb, 13 of them (Mono Violet). Not the HUD palette. Meanings: 12-art-and-audio.md, Screen colors.

ship_lines.description: The main line: the FALL card's color (its topic and icon lines).

ship_lines_light.description: The second line: the PAUSE card's color and the rock's lines in the GRAZE icon.

frame_lights.description: Lights: borders, corner brackets, scan lines, key caps, the selected choice's fade and brackets, the picker cursor, the ruler ticks.

panel_body.description: The glass: every box and card fill.

level.description: Gold: the level reached (LV) and the coins.

hearts.description: The heart in the FALL icon.

last_life.description: Warning: the WARNING card's color and the ship's flame in the FLY icon.

rank_1.description: First place: the leaderboard's top row.

rank_2.description: Second place: the leaderboard's second row.

rank_3.description: Third place: the leaderboard's third row.

glass.description: The see-through panel every box and card shares.

fill_alpha.description: How opaque the dark panel_body fill is, 0 to 255. About 56% is 143.

border_alpha.description: How opaque the thin border is, 0 to 255.

bracket_len.description: Length of each arm of a corner bracket, px.

bracket_w.description: Thickness of a corner bracket, px.

bracket_out.description: How many px outside the box's edge the brackets sit, 0 or more.

scan_pitch.description: Rows between two scan lines, 1 or more.

scan_alpha.description: How opaque a scan line is, 0 to 255.

blur_down.description: How many times smaller the picture behind a box is made before it is scaled back up: the blur. 1 is no blur.

glow.description: The soft glow, drawn once and kept. A strength of 0 turns that glow off.

box_radius.description: Glow round a panel's border and brackets, px.

icon_radius.description: Glow behind an icon's lines, px.

fonts.description: The screens' font file and one entry per text role.

text_file.description: Path of the font file under game/assets/. Share Tech Mono.

roles.description: One entry for every role in the enum, each named once and no other: the loader refuses a missing, repeated or unknown role.

name.description: The role's name. One of: title, message, menu_title, menu_item, button, label, digit, picker, key, hint, row, top_name, top_score, level, card_title, card_text, empty.

size.description: Font size in px, 1 or more.

spacing.description: Letter-spacing in em: 0.3 is 30% of the font's height between characters. 0 or more.

rulers.description: The tick marks down both sides of a full-window page.

inset_x.description: Distance of the ticks from the window's side edge, px.

inset_y.description: Distance of the first and last tick from the top and bottom edge, px.

w.description: Length of the longest tick, px. Short ticks are 5/8 of it.

major_pitch.description: Rows between two long ticks, px. A multiple of minor_pitch: the loader refuses any other.

minor_alpha.description: How opaque a short tick is, 0 to 255.

major_alpha.description: How opaque a long tick is, 0 to 255.

minor_w.description: Length of a short tick, px. 0 or more.

keycap.description: The small key caps (ENTER, SPACE, the arrows) and the gaps round them.

min_w.description: Narrowest a key cap gets, px. An arrow key is this wide.

pad_x.description: Space each side of the label inside a text key cap, px.

fill_alpha.description: How opaque the faint fill is, 0 to 255.

border_alpha.description: How opaque the border is, 0 to 255.

gap.description: Space between two key caps in a row, px.

hint_gap.description: Space between the last key cap and the word after it, px.

group_gap.description: Space between two hints in the name picker's hint row, px.

word_alpha.description: How bright the short word after the key caps is, 0 to 255 (153 is about 60%).

play_w.description: Width of the small play triangle that closes the pause hint, px. 1 or more.

arrow_size.description: Half the size of an arrow drawn on an arrow key, px. 0 or more.

choice.description: A choice: RETRY, MENU or a menu item.

fade_alpha.description: How opaque the cyan fade behind the selected choice is at its middle, 0 to 255.

bracket_inset.description: Distance of the [ and ] from the choice's left and right edge, px.

dim_alpha.description: How bright a choice is when it is not selected, 0 to 255.

off_alpha.description: How bright a choice is when it can't be picked yet (the picker still takes the keys), 0 to 255.

gap.description: Space between the word PAUSE and the key caps under it, px.

blur.description: Whether the picture behind the box is blurred, drawn live every frame.

game_over.description: The game-over box with and without the name picker. The lines are spread evenly between the top and bottom padding.

w.description: Box width without the picker, px.

h.description: Box height without the picker, px.

picker_w.description: Box width with the picker, px. At least w.

picker_h.description: Box height with the picker, px. At least h.

pad_top.description: Space above the first line without the picker, px.

pad_bottom.description: Space below RETRY and MENU, px.

picker_pad_top.description: Space above the first line with the picker, px.

score_digits.description: Fewest digits the score shows. A shorter score gets dim leading zeros; a longer one shows in full.

score_gap.description: Space between the label SCORE and the digits, px.

score_cell_w.description: Width of one digit cell, px.

score_group_gap.description: Space between two groups of three digits, px.

choice_w.description: Width of RETRY's and MENU's rect, px.

choice_gap.description: Space between RETRY and MENU, px.

slot_w.description: Width of one picker slot, px.

slot_h.description: Height of one picker slot, px.

slot_pad_y.description: Room above and below the slot row for the cursor's arrows, px.

slot_line_w.description: Thickness of the line under each slot, px.

slot_line_alpha.description: How opaque that line is on a slot that isn't the cursor's, 0 to 255.

cursor_alpha.description: How opaque the cyan fill on the cursor's slot is, 0 to 255.

arrow_size.description: Half the width of the cursor's arrows, px.

arrow_gap.description: Space between the cursor's slot and each arrow, px.

blur.description: Whether the picture behind the box is blurred, drawn live every frame.

label_alpha.description: How bright the label SCORE is, 0 to 255.

dim_digit_alpha.description: How bright a leading zero of the score is, 0 to 255.

menu.description: The menu: title, the four items, hint. All centered in the window.

item_w.description: Width of each item's rect, px.

item_h.description: Height of each item's rect, px.

title_gap.description: Space between the title and the first item, px.

hint_bottom.description: Distance of the hint line's bottom from the window's bottom edge, px.

hint_alpha.description: How bright the hint line is, 0 to 255.

instructions.description: The instructions page: a card grid between the title and the footer.

margin_x.description: Space between the window's side edges and the grid, px.

head_h.description: Height of the band that holds the title, px.

foot_h.description: Height of the band that holds the footer, px.

columns.description: Cards per row, 1 or more. Six cards fill the rows.

icon_w.description: Width of a card's icon box, px.

icon_h.description: Height of a card's icon box, px.

pad_x.description: Space between a card's edge and its content, px.

pad_y.description: Least space above and below the icon in its card, px.

text_gap.description: Space between the icon box and the text, px.

caption_gap.description: Space between a card's topic and its caption, px.

foot_group_gap.description: Space between the footer's two key groups (BACK and the music mute), px.

blur.description: Whether the picture behind the cards is blurred, drawn live every frame. Off keeps the frame rate on the moving background.

caption_alpha.description: How bright a caption is against full plating, 0 to 255.

coin_scale.description: The COINS card's game coin sprites, times their size in play (1.0 is the size in play).

common_coin_frame.description: The frame of the common coin's strip the COINS card shows, from 0. Must be in the strip.

rare_coin_frame.description: The frame of the rare coin's strip the COINS card shows, from 0: one that shows its glint. Must be in the strip.

leaderboard.description: The leaderboard page: the title, the table of the top 10, the footer.

head_h.description: Height of the band that holds the title, px.

foot_h.description: Height of the band that holds the footer, px.

table_w.description: Width of the table, centered, px.

top_h.description: Height of one medal row (places 1 to 3), px.

top_gap.description: Space between two medal rows, px.

row_h.description: Height of one plain row (places 4 to 10), px.

rest_gap.description: Space between the medal rows and the plain rows, px.

pad_x.description: Space between a row's edge and its content, px.

place_w.description: Width of the place cell in a plain row, px.

top_place_w.description: Width of the place cell (the medal) in a medal row, px.

score_w.description: Width of the score column in a plain row, px.

top_score_w.description: Width of the score column in a medal row, px.

level_w.description: Width of the level column (LV n), px.

medal_size.description: Side of the crown and medal pictures, px.

rule_alpha.description: How opaque the thin line under each plain row is, 0 to 255.

empty_top.description: Space between the head band and the empty-list line, px.

blur.description: Whether the picture behind the medal rows is blurred, drawn live every frame. Off keeps the frame rate on the moving background.

empty_alpha.description: How bright the empty-list line is, 0 to 255.

place_alpha.description: How bright a plain row's place number is, 0 to 255.

medal_fill_alpha.description: Alpha of the fill inside a second or third place medal, 0 to 255.

credits.description: The credits page: the title, one glass card per credit group, the footer. Each card is as tall as its lines; the stack is centered between the title band and the footer band.

margin_bottom.description: Space below the footer band, px.

head_h.description: Height of the band that holds the title, px.

foot_h.description: Height of the band that holds the footer, px.

card_w.description: Width of every card, px. The cards are centered across the window.

pad_x.description: Space between a card's left edge and its text, px.

pad_y.description: Space above the heading and below the last line inside a card, px.

heading_gap.description: Space between a card's heading and its first line, px.

line_gap.description: Extra space below each line of a card, px.

text_alpha.description: How bright a plain credit line is, 0 to 255.

link_alpha.description: How bright a link line is, 0 to 255.

blur.description: Whether the picture behind the cards is blurred, drawn live every frame. Off keeps the frame rate on the moving background.

version.description: The version label: small dim text in the bottom-left corner of the menu and the full-window pages, never during a run. Role hint, plating, no glow.

margin_left.description: Distance of the text's left edge from the window's left edge, px.

margin_bottom.description: Distance of the text's bottom from the window's bottom edge, px.

text_alpha.description: How bright the text is, 0 to 255.
